# Doctor's Quick Reference
## External bleeding
1. Select the area on the targeting UI. 2. Empty hand: direct pressure. 3. Gauze: bandage the selected external wound. 4. Brutepack: apply a hemostatic to the selected external wound. 5. Tourniquet: apply to the canonical arm or leg region. 6. Re-scan and restore the lost volume.
## Loss of consciousness or circulation
1. Check oxygen, circulating blood, perfusion, and rhythm. 2. Stop external blood sources. 3. Apply oxygen or NCManualVentilator. 4. If perfusion is absent, perform CPR with an empty hand. 5. If Shockable Arrest is present, use Defibrillator. 6. Administer compatible blood or crystalloid. 7. Re-scan.
## Fracture
1. Select the damaged area. 2. Apply NCFieldSplint for temporary stabilization. 3. Confirm the fracture with a full scanner. 4. Perform: Cautery → Scalpel → Hemostat → Retractor → Drill → Drill → Drill → MedicatedSuture.
## Internal injury
1. Place the patient in MedicalScanner. 2. Open computerBodyScanner. 3. Check Regions, Wounds, Organs, Cyberware, and Drugs. 4. Select a body region. 5. Perform the corresponding operation from the Surgery section. 6. Re-scan fully.
